```{r set_up_inuring_graph_loss_data}
loss_allocation_tbl <- read_csv("demo_business/loss_allocation_walkthrough.csv")

graph_nodes_tbl <- read_parquet("demo_business/nodes_tbl.parquet")
graph_edges_tbl <- read_parquet("demo_business/edges_tbl.parquet")
```

```{r set_up_basics_examples}
#| echo: false

qs_cession <- 0.25

qs_tbl <- tibble(gross_loss = c(2e6, 10e6, 40e6)) |>
  mutate(
    ceded = qs_recovery(gross_loss, qs_cession),
    net   = gross_loss - ceded
    )

tower_loss <- 14e6

tower_tbl <- tibble(
  layer      = c("L1", "L2"),
  attachment = c(5e6, 10e6),
  limit      = c(5e6, 10e6)
  )

tower_recovery_tbl <- tower_recoveries(tower_loss, tower_tbl) |>
  transmute(
    layer,
    band     = glue("{fmt_limit(limit)}XS{fmt_limit(attachment)}"),
    recovery
    )

tower_retained <- tower_loss - sum(tower_recovery_tbl$recovery)

tower_display_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    layer    = "Retained",
    band     = glue("Below {fmt_m(min(tower_tbl$attachment))}"),
    recovery = tower_retained
    ),
  tower_recovery_tbl
  )

period_loss_vec <- c(8e6, 9e6, 10e6)
layer_attach    <- 5e6
layer_limit     <- 5e6
n_reinstate     <- 1

period_tbl <- tibble(
  event_loss    = period_loss_vec,
  occurrence    = period_recoveries(period_loss_vec, layer_attach, layer_limit),
  reinstatement = period_recoveries(
    period_loss_vec, layer_attach, layer_limit,
    cap = layer_limit * (1 + n_reinstate)
    ),
  aggregate     = period_recoveries(
    period_loss_vec, layer_attach, layer_limit,
    cap = layer_limit
    )
  )

order_loss    <- 10e6
order_cession <- 0.30

order_qs  <- \(x) qs_recovery(x, order_cession)
order_xol <- \(x) xol_recovery(x, attachment = 5e6, limit = 5e6)

order_tbl <- tibble(
  sequence = c("QS then XoL", "XoL then QS"),
  result   = list(
    apply_in_order(order_loss, list(order_qs, order_xol)),
    apply_in_order(order_loss, list(order_xol, order_qs))
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    first_ceded  = map_dbl(result, \(r) r$ceded[1]),
    second_ceded = map_dbl(result, \(r) r$ceded[2]),
    total_ceded  = first_ceded + second_ceded,
    net          = map_dbl(result, "subject")
    )
```

```{r set_up_class_engine}
#| echo: false

# Region x line loss classes, perils, events, risks; explicit inuring engine.
# Everything below is computed at render time from fixed seeds (about 1.5 s).
source("class_model.R", keep.source = TRUE)
source("class_engine.R", keep.source = TRUE)

cw      <- class_world()
cres    <- run_inuring_engine(cw)
gen_res <- run_inuring_engine(cw, cw$inuring_generator, on_invalid = "ignore")
ord_chk <- order_sensitivity(cw, cw$inuring, n_random = 20)

treaty_tbl <- cw$data$treaty_df
cls_tbl    <- cw$class_table

fmt_bn  <- label_number(accuracy = 0.1, scale = 1e-9, suffix = "bn")
fmt_bn2 <- label_number(accuracy = 0.01, scale = 1e-9, suffix = "bn")
fmt_amt <- \(x) if_else(x >= 1e9, fmt_bn(x), fmt_m(x))
fmt_m0  <- label_number(accuracy = 1, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "m")

# "Casualty Liability (P001 2.1) 17XS5" -> "Casualty Liability 2.1 17XS5"
short_name <- \(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace("\\(P001 ([0-9.]+)\\)", "\\1") |>
    str_replace("^P001 Segment", "Segment") |>
    str_replace("^Portfolio 001", "Portfolio")
}

type_lbl <- c(
  quota_share = "Quota share", group_quota_share = "Group quota share",
  surplus = "Surplus", xol_per_risk = "XoL per risk",
  xol_per_occurrence = "XoL per occurrence", clash = "Clash",
  aggregate_xl = "Aggregate XL", stop_loss = "Stop loss", ilw = "ILW"
  )

# Okabe-Ito: proportional types in blues/greens, excess of loss in oranges
type_col <- c(
  group_quota_share = "#0072B2", quota_share = "#56B4E9", surplus = "#009E73",
  stop_loss = "#CC79A7", xol_per_risk = "#E69F00", xol_per_occurrence = "#D55E00",
  aggregate_xl = "#F0E442", clash = "#999999", ilw = "#000000"
  )

peril_col <- c(
  Earthquake = "#D55E00", Windstorm = "#0072B2", Flood = "#56B4E9",
  Fire = "#E69F00", Liability = "#009E73", Cyber = "#CC79A7",
  Marine = "#F0E442", Background = "grey70"
  )

region_tbl <- region_table()
geo_col <- c(
  "North America" = "#0072B2", "Europe" = "#E69F00", "UK & Ireland" = "#009E73",
  "Asia Pacific" = "#D55E00", "Latin America" = "#CC79A7",
  "Middle East & Africa" = "#56B4E9"
  )

slide_theme <- theme(
  text        = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text   = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title  = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
  strip.text  = element_text(size = 16)
  )

# one label per class for charts: line | region code
cls_lbl <- cls_tbl |>
  left_join(region_tbl |> select(region, region_code), by = "region") |>
  transmute(class_id, label = str_c(lob, " | ", region_code))

peril_event_tbl <- cw$events_sim |>
  filter(kind == "peril")

event_peril_tbl <- cw$events_sim |>
  mutate(peril = if_else(kind == "background", "Background", peril))
```


```{r set_up_loss_examples}
#| echo: false

# the largest event, its classes, and the biggest class split into risks
big_event <- peril_event_tbl |> slice_max(gross, n = 1)

big_class_tbl <- cres$rows |>
  filter(event_id == big_event$event_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_risks = n(), gross = sum(gross_loss), largest = max(gross_loss),
    .by = c(class_id, region)
    ) |>
  arrange(desc(gross)) |>
  left_join(cls_lbl, by = "class_id")

big_class_rows <- cres$rows |>
  filter(event_id == big_event$event_id, class_id == big_class_tbl$class_id[1]) |>
  arrange(desc(gross_loss))

total_gross  <- sum(cres$rows$gross_loss)
big_share    <- big_event$gross / total_gross
loss_orders  <- round(log10(max(cres$rows$gross_loss) / min(cres$rows$gross_loss)))

period_peril_tbl <- cw$events_sim |>
  mutate(peril = if_else(kind == "background", "Background", peril)) |>
  summarise(gross = sum(gross), .by = c(period_id, peril)) |>
  mutate(peril = factor(peril, levels = names(peril_col)))

stopifnot(abs(sum(period_peril_tbl$gross) - total_gross) < 1)
```


```{r set_up_orchestration_examples}
#| echo: false

bridge_tbl <- cw$bridge

treaties_per_class <- bridge_tbl |> count(class_id, name = "n")
classes_per_treaty <- bridge_tbl |> count(treaty_id, name = "n")

# one treaty = a filter (lines x regions); the classes it expands to
filter_pick <- cw$filters |>
  left_join(classes_per_treaty |> rename(n_classes = n), by = "treaty_id") |>
  filter(
    treaty_type %in% c("xol_per_risk", "xol_per_occurrence", "clash"),
    n_lobs >= 2, n_regions >= 2, between(n_classes, 4, 6)
    ) |>
  arrange(desc(restricted), treaty_id) |>
  slice(1)

filter_name <- short_name(treaty_tbl$name[match(filter_pick$treaty_id, treaty_tbl$treaty_id)])

filter_class_tbl <- bridge_tbl |>
  filter(treaty_id == filter_pick$treaty_id) |>
  left_join(cls_tbl |> select(class_id, lob, region), by = "class_id") |>
  transmute(`Line of business` = lob, Region = region)

# the widest event: how many treaties see it, how many pay
anat <- loss_anatomy2(cres)
wide <- anat$examples$widest

# six rows of the explicit inuring table
inuring_show_tbl <- cw$inuring |>
  mutate(h = hash_unif(paste(from_treaty_id, to_treaty_id), "show")) |>
  arrange(h) |>
  slice_head(n = 6) |>
  transmute(
    `Child (net of its parent)` = short_name(to_name),
    Parent = short_name(from_name)
    ) |>
  select(Parent, `Child (net of its parent)`)

# A -> B -> C in the generator's table with A -> C missing although A and C share classes
gen_tbl <- cw$inuring_generator
pair_tbl <- unit_pairs(cw$bridge, treaty_tbl)
chain_tbl <- gen_tbl |>
  inner_join(
    gen_tbl, by = c("to_treaty_id" = "from_treaty_id"),
    suffix = c("_ab", "_bc"), relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
  transmute(
    a = from_treaty_id, b = to_treaty_id, z = to_treaty_id_bc,
    ta = from_type_ab, tb = to_type_ab, tz = to_type_bc,
    na = from_name_ab, nb = to_name_ab, nz = to_name_bc
    ) |>
  filter(
    a != z, ta != tb, tb != tz, ta != tz,
    !paste(a, z) %in% paste(gen_tbl$from_treaty_id, gen_tbl$to_treaty_id),
    pair_key(a, z) %in% pair_key(pair_tbl$a, pair_tbl$b)
    ) |>
  mutate(h = hash_unif(paste(a, b, z), "chain")) |>
  arrange(h) |>
  slice(1)

# a loss row where a proportional treaty and an excess-of-loss treaty both pay
both_row <- cres$ledger |>
  filter(ceded > 0) |>
  mutate(proportional = treaty_type %in% c("quota_share", "group_quota_share", "surplus")) |>
  summarise(
    n_pay = n(), any_prop = any(proportional),
    any_xol = any(treaty_type %in% c("xol_per_risk", "xol_per_occurrence", "clash")),
    gross = cres$rows$gross_loss[first(row_id)],
    .by = row_id
    ) |>
  filter(n_pay == 2, any_prop, any_xol) |>
  slice_max(gross, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

both_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Step = "Gross loss", `Subject loss` = both_row$gross, Ceded = NA_real_),
  cres$ledger |>
    filter(row_id == both_row$row_id, ceded > 0) |>
    arrange(desc(subject_loss_in)) |>
    transmute(
      Step = str_c(type_lbl[treaty_type], ": ", short_name(treaty_name)),
      `Subject loss` = subject_loss_in, Ceded = ceded
      ),
  tibble(
    Step = "Net loss", `Subject loss` = cres$rows$net_loss[both_row$row_id], Ceded = NA_real_
    )
  )

stopifnot(near(both_row$gross - sum(both_tbl$Ceded, na.rm = TRUE), both_tbl$`Subject loss`[4]))

# the generator's thin table against the repaired one
gen_diag    <- inuring_diagnostics(cw, cw$inuring_generator, gen_res)
gen_oc      <- over_recovery(gen_res)
gen_neg_ev  <- gen_res$rows |>
  filter(net_loss < -1e-9 * pmax(1, gross_loss)) |>
  summarise(n = n_distinct(event_id)) |>
  pull(n)
rep_oc      <- over_recovery(cres)

# peer exceptions that keep the outcome valid
peer_tbl <- pick_valid_peer_exceptions(cw, n = 3, base = cres)
peer_searched <- attr(peer_tbl, "searched")
peer_res <- run_inuring_engine(apply_peer_exceptions(cw, peer_tbl), on_invalid = "ignore")
peer_oc  <- over_recovery(peer_res)

# ceded before and after, from the primary run and the run with all exceptions applied together
peer_tbl <- peer_tbl |>
  mutate(
    ceded_before = map_dbl(to_treaty_id, \(id) sum(cres$ledger$ceded[cres$ledger$treaty_id == id])),
    ceded_after  = map_dbl(to_treaty_id, \(id) sum(peer_res$ledger$ceded[peer_res$ledger$treaty_id == id]))
    )

order_worst <- ord_chk$worst$max_abs_row_diff
n_orders    <- nrow(ord_chk$table)
```


```{r set_up_class_summary}
#| echo: false

# provenance of the treaty structure, read from the data directory's README: tier / seed / periods
mega_prov <- readLines("data_mega/README.md") |>
  str_subset(fixed("Tier / seed / phase / periods")) |>
  str_match("`(\\w+)` / (\\d+) / .* / (\\d+) \\|")

mega_tier    <- mega_prov[1, 2]
mega_seed    <- mega_prov[1, 3]

# headline totals, and the conservation check gross = net + ceded
tot_gross <- sum(cres$rows$gross_loss)
tot_net   <- sum(cres$rows$net_loss)
tot_ceded <- sum(cres$ledger$ceded)

stopifnot(
  abs(tot_gross - tot_net - tot_ceded) < 1,
  as.integer(mega_prov[1, 4]) == nrow(cw$data$period_df),
  nrow(treaty_tbl) == mega_stats_lst$treaties,
  nrow(cw$data$edges_df) == mega_stats_lst$edges
  )

ceded_type_tbl <- recoveries_by(cres, treaty_type) |>
  arrange(desc(ceded))

prop_share <- ceded_type_tbl |>
  filter(treaty_type %in% c("quota_share", "group_quota_share", "surplus")) |>
  pull(ceded) |>
  sum() / tot_ceded

top_treaty_tbl <- recoveries_by(cres, treaty_id, treaty_name, treaty_type) |>
  slice_max(ceded, n = 10) |>
  mutate(label = short_name(treaty_name))

exhausted_tbl <- exhaustion(cres) |>
  filter(exhausted) |>
  count(level, treaty_type)

inv_tbl <- engine_invariants(cw, cres, ord_chk)

# the biggest event, step by step in order of application (a tower is one step)
trace_event <- big_event$event_id
trace_gross <- big_event$gross
trace_net   <- cres$events |> filter(event_id == trace_event) |> pull(net)

trace_unit_tbl <- cres$ledger |>
  filter(event_id == trace_event, ceded > 0) |>
  mutate(unit = cres$treaties$unit[match(treaty_id, cres$treaties$treaty_id)]) |>
  summarise(ceded = sum(ceded), .by = unit) |>
  left_join(cres$units |> select(unit, name, treaty_type), by = "unit") |>
  mutate(position = match(unit, cres$order))

trace_top_tbl <- trace_unit_tbl |>
  slice_max(ceded, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(position)

trace_other_tbl <- trace_unit_tbl |>
  filter(!unit %in% trace_top_tbl$unit) |>
  summarise(ceded = sum(ceded), n = n())

trace_payer_tbl <- bind_rows(
  trace_top_tbl |> transmute(step = short_name(name), ceded, treaty_type),
  trace_other_tbl |>
    transmute(step = str_c(n, " other treaties"), ceded, treaty_type = "other")
  )

stopifnot(abs(trace_gross - sum(trace_payer_tbl$ceded) - trace_net) < 1)
```

# Reinsurance Basics

---

*Cedants*

\


transfer premium/risk to

\


*Reinsurers*

---

Capacity

\


Volatility

\


Capital

---

$$
\text{Gross Loss} = \text{Ceded} + \text{Retained}
$$



### Quota Share (QS)

\


Proportional

\


Share of premium and losses

---

25% Quota Share

\


```{r show_qs_example}
#| echo: false

qs_tbl |>
  transmute(
    `Gross loss`  = fmt_m(gross_loss),
    !!glue("Ceded ({percent(qs_cession)} QS)") := fmt_m(ceded),
    `Net retained` = fmt_m(net)
    ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "rrr")
```


### Excess of Loss (XoL)

\

Non-proportional: pays only above *attachment*

\


Paid upfront

\


*Limit* XS *Attach*

---

14m Loss

\


```{r show_tower_example}
#| echo: false

tower_display_tbl |>
  transmute(Layer = layer, Band = band, Recovery = fmt_m(recovery)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llr")
```

---

Who pays at each loss size

```{r show_tower_allocation}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.6
#| fig-align: center

region_lvl <- c("Above tower", tower_tbl$layer[2], tower_tbl$layer[1], "Retention")
region_lbl <- c(
  "Retention"   = "Retained by cedant",
  setNames(
    glue("{tower_tbl$layer} ({fmt_limit(tower_tbl$limit)}XS{fmt_limit(tower_tbl$attachment)})"),
    tower_tbl$layer
    ),
  "Above tower" = "Above tower (cedant)"
  )
region_col <- c(
  "Retention" = "grey60", "L1" = "#0072B2", "L2" = "#E69F00", "Above tower" = "grey90"
  )

alloc_loss_vec <- c(3e6, 7e6, 12e6, 20e6, 25e6)
tower_top      <- max(tower_tbl$attachment + tower_tbl$limit)

# The tower bar: each region at its true height (retention is everything below the first layer)
tower_bar_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(region = "Retention", amount = min(tower_tbl$attachment)),
  tower_tbl |> transmute(region = layer, amount = limit)
  ) |>
  mutate(bar = "Tower")

alloc_tbl <- tibble(gross_loss = alloc_loss_vec) |>
  mutate(allocation = map(gross_loss, tower_allocation, layers = tower_tbl)) |>
  unnest(allocation) |>
  mutate(bar = fmt_limit(gross_loss) |> paste0("m"))

# Every loss is fully allocated: retention + recoveries + above tower = gross loss
stopifnot(
  alloc_tbl |>
    summarise(total = sum(amount), .by = c(gross_loss)) |>
    summarise(all(near(total, gross_loss))) |>
    pull(),
  near(sum(tower_bar_tbl$amount), tower_top)
  )

bar_lvl <- c("Tower", unique(alloc_tbl$bar))

bind_rows(tower_bar_tbl, alloc_tbl) |>
  mutate(
    region = factor(region, levels = region_lvl),
    bar    = factor(bar, levels = bar_lvl)
    ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bar, y = amount, fill = region)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(linetype = region),
      position = "stack", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, width = 0.7
      ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(tower_tbl$attachment, tower_top),
      linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40"
      ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_col, labels = region_lbl, breaks = rev(region_lvl)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Retention" = "solid", "L1" = "solid", "L2" = "solid", "Above tower" = "dashed"),
      guide = "none"
      ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, tower_tbl$attachment, tower_top, max(alloc_loss_vec)),
      labels = \(x) fmt_limit(x) |> paste0("m")
      ) +
    labs(x = "Gross loss", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right"
      )
```



### Limits and Reinstatements

---

Occurrence limit: single event

\


Aggregate limit: all events

\


Reinstatement: limit restored, usually for extra premium

---

Capacity = limit $\times$ (1 + reinstatements)

```{r show_treaty_data}
    `Treaty ID` = treaty_id,
    `Type`      = treaty_type,
    `Name`      = name,
    `Attach`    = attachment,
    `Limit`     = limit,
    `Cession`   = cession_pct
    ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lllrrr")
  
```

# Treaties as Functions

---

$$
Treaty: \text{Losses} \rightarrow \text{Recoveries}
$$


## Recovery Accounting

---

### 10XS10 XoL

\


10 million excess of 10 million

---

| Segment      | Gross Loss |
|--------------|-----------:|
| Construction |       5.0M |
| Legal        |      10.0M |
| I.T.         |       5.0M |
|              |            |
| Total        |      20.0M |


---

Treaty recovers 10M

---

How do we allocate them?

---

| Segment      | Treaty  | Recovery |
|--------------|---------|---------:|
| Construction | 10XS10  |     2.5M |
| Legal        | 10XS10  |     5.0M |
| I.T.         | 10XS10  |     2.5M |
|              |         |          |
| Total        | 10XS10  |    10.0M |


---

### 25% QS

\


25% quota-share (often with a limit)

---

| Segment      | Gross Loss |
|--------------|-----------:|
| Construction |       5.0M |
| Legal        |      10.0M |
| I.T.         |       5.0M |
|              |            |
| Total        |      20.0M |


---

Treaty recovers 5M

---


| Segment      | Treaty  | Recovery |
|--------------|---------|---------:|
| Construction | 25% QS  |    1.25M |
| Legal        | 25% QS  |    2.50M |
| I.T.         | 25% QS  |    1.25M |
|              |         |          |
| Total        | 25% QS  |    5.00M |



# Inuring

---

Sequencing of treaties


## Gross / Subject Losses

---

Subject Loss = Gross Loss - Inuring Recoveries

---

```{r show single_node_connected}
#| echo: false

target_node <- "XOL02_L1"  # node name/value to match

node_id <- inuring_tblgraph |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  filter(treaty_id == target_node) |>
  pull(row_id)

treaty_subgraph <- inuring_tblgraph |>
  convert(
    to_local_neighborhood,
    node  = node_id,
    order = 1,
    mode  = "in"
    )

treaty_subgraph |>
  ggraph(layout = "stress") +
  geom_edge_link(arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm")), end_cap = circle(3, "mm")) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = treaty_id)) +
  theme_graph()
```




## Topological Sort


---

Inuring graph dictates calculation order

---

```{r show_full_graph}
#| echo: false

graph_layout <- inuring_tblgraph |> igraph::layout_with_fr()

ggraph(inuring_tblgraph, layout = graph_layout) +
  geom_edge_link(
    arrow  = arrow(angle = 14, type = "closed"),
    colour = "darkgrey"
    ) +
  geom_node_label(
    aes(label = treaty_id),
    size  = 2,
    repel = FALSE
    ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0.03)) +
  theme_graph()

```

---

::: {.custom-small}
```{r show_inuring_sort}
#| echo: false

topo_order <- inuring_tblgraph |>
  igraph::topo_sort(mode = "out")

inuring_tblgraph |>
  activate(nodes) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  slice(as.integer(topo_order)) |>
  transmute(
    calc_order = row_number(),
    treaty_id, treaty_type, treaty_label, description
    ) |>
  head(15) |>
  knitr::kable()

```
:::


# Orchestration

---


::: {.custom-small}
```
1. Construct graph
2. Construct treaty functions
3. Determine treaty/loss coverage
4. Topological sort
5. Loop over each node:

    a. List inuring treaties
    b. List inuring losses/recoveries
    c. Keep covered losses/recoveries
    d. Calculate subject losses
    e. Calculate recoveries

6. Gather all per-node outputs
7. Construct outputs
```
:::

```{r show_gross_net_by_period}

period_sum_tbl <- class_summary(cres, period_id)
top_period <- period_sum_tbl |> slice_max(gross, n = 1)

period_sum_tbl |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period_id)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = period_id, y = net, yend = gross), colour = "grey50", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y = gross, colour = "Gross"), size = 5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = net, colour = "Net"), size = 5) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = top_period$period_id, y = top_period$gross * 1.5, size = 5,
      label = glue("{str_to_lower(big_event$peril)}: {fmt_bn(big_event$gross)}")
      ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Gross" = "#D55E00", "Net" = "#0072B2")) +
    scale_y_log10(
      breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10) * 1e9,
      labels = label_number(scale = 1e-9, suffix = "bn", drop0trailing = TRUE),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2))
      ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Loss (log scale)", colour = NULL) +
    slide_theme
```

### Loss Apportionment

\


```{r show_event_trace}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center

trace_step_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(step = "Gross loss", xmin = 0, xmax = trace_gross, kind = "gross", label = fmt_bn(trace_gross)),
  trace_payer_tbl |>
    mutate(xmax = trace_gross - lag(cumsum(ceded), default = 0), xmin = xmax - ceded) |>
    transmute(step, xmin, xmax, kind = treaty_type, label = str_c("-", fmt_amt(ceded))),
  tibble(step = "Net loss", xmin = 0, xmax = trace_net, kind = "net", label = fmt_bn(trace_net))
  ) |>
  mutate(step = factor(step, levels = rev(step)), row = as.integer(step))

ggplot(trace_step_tbl) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = row - 0.4, ymax = row + 0.4, fill = kind)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = xmax, y = row, label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(trace_step_tbl$step)), labels = levels(trace_step_tbl$step)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-9, suffix = "bn"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(type_col, gross = "grey35", net = "grey15", other = "grey60"),
    breaks = unique(trace_payer_tbl$treaty_type[trace_payer_tbl$treaty_type != "other"]),
    labels = \(x) unname(type_lbl[x])
    ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  slide_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
